title: Add CRUD item endpoints to the FastAPI health endpoint app
description: Frontend-feature task on backend_health_endpoint: the app has only GET /items. Add POST /items (create), GET /items/{item_id} (fetch), and DELETE /items/{item_id} (remove). Use an in-memory dict store. Existing GET /items test must still pass.

required_artifacts: POST /items creates item with auto-incremented id, returns 201
GET /items returns all stored items (empty on fresh state)
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (all tests)
uv run python -c "from src.app import app" passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.app import app"
